name: Heaven's Secret: Requiem
source:
Demon spawn and the infected overrun the world. Humanity’s remnants struggle to survive in this harsh new reality, with no room for feelings. Yet even amid the ashes, true love may blossom...

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven%27s_Secret:_Requiem]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
恶魔大量繁殖，感染者遍布世界。人类的残余在这个严酷的新现实中挣扎着生存，没有感情的余地。然而，即使在灰烬中，真爱也可能绽放……

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven%27s_Secret:_Requiem]romance-club.fandom[/url]
